function TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item): (TypeDef?, string?)
	for typeName, typeDef in pairs(TypeRegistry.Types) do
		if typeDef.classCheck(item) then
			return typeDef, typeName
		end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

function TypeRegistry.getTypeName(item): string?
	local _, name = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	return name
end

function TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	return item:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME)
end

-- Resolve attrName overrides (BeamBrightness, PLRange, etc.); falls back to propName.
function TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName): string
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if propDef and propDef.attrName then
		return propDef.attrName
	end
	return propName
end

-- Read property value; enum returns EnumItem (not string).
-- A scalar saved before the property became a graph or a range reads as the flat equivalent.
local function promoteScalar(propDef, raw)
	if type(raw) ~= "number" then return raw end
	if propDef.type == "NumberSequence" then return NumberSequence.new(raw) end
	if propDef.type == "NumberRange" then return NumberRange.new(raw) end
	return raw
end

function TypeRegistry.read(item, propName): any
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if not propDef then return nil end

	if typeDef.directAccess then
		if propDef.attribute then
			local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
			local raw = item:GetAttribute(attrName)
			-- Explicit nil-check so stored `false` round-trips correctly.
			if raw ~= nil then return raw end
			return propDef.default
		end
		local ok, val = pcall(function() return item[propName] end)
		if ok and val ~= nil then return val end
		return propDef.default
	end

	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end

	local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)
	local raw = config:GetAttribute(attrName)

	if raw == nil then return propDef.default end
	raw = promoteScalar(propDef, raw)

	if propDef.type == "enum" and type(raw) == "string" then
		-- Enum[type][name] raises on invalid names; pcall-wrap.
		local ok, enumVal = pcall(function() return Enum[propDef.enumType][raw] end)
		if ok and enumVal then return enumVal end
		return propDef.default
	end

	return raw
end

-- Bump RT _PoolGen so Pool flushes stale-look entries on next acquire. Inlined to keep
-- TypeRegistry's no-upward-dependency invariant (would otherwise require Pool).
local function _bumpPoolGen(item)
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not rt then return end
	local cur = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
end

-- Bump RenderTemplate's _PoolGen so pooled visuals invalidate. UI paths that
-- mutate RT directly (Material, Beam Texture, Attachment0/1) call this.
function TypeRegistry.bumpPoolGen(item)
	if not item then return end
	_bumpPoolGen(item)
end

-- Clamp NumberSequence so each keypoint Value >= 0 and Envelope <= Value.
local function _clampNonNegativeSeq(value)
	if typeof(value) ~= "NumberSequence" then return value end
	local kps = value.Keypoints
	local needsClamp = false
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		if kp.Value < 0 or kp.Envelope > kp.Value then needsClamp = true; break end
	end
	if not needsClamp then return value end
	local clamped = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		local v = math.max(0, kp.Value)
		local e = math.max(0, math.min(kp.Envelope, v))
		table.insert(clamped, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, v, e))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(clamped)
end

-- NaN/invalid guard: refuse writes that would persist garbage (NaN keypoints, infinite
-- numbers, malformed NumberSequence). Runtime guards degrade gracefully but stale-invalid
-- attrs survive across sessions and silently misbehave; reject at the write boundary so
-- the prior good value stays intact.
local function _isInvalidNumber(n)
	return type(n) == "number" and (n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge)
end
local function _isInvalidValue(value)
	if type(value) == "number" then return _isInvalidNumber(value) end
	if typeof(value) == "NumberRange" then return _isInvalidNumber(value.Min) or _isInvalidNumber(value.Max) end
	if typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
		for _, kp in ipairs(value.Keypoints) do
			if _isInvalidNumber(kp.Time) or _isInvalidNumber(kp.Value) or _isInvalidNumber(kp.Envelope) then
				return true
			end
			if kp.Time < 0 or kp.Time > 1 then return true end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Write property value; enum stored as Name string (config) or EnumItem (direct).
function TypeRegistry.write(item, propName, value)
	if _isInvalidValue(value) then
		warn("[Part-Icles] TypeRegistry.write rejected invalid value for " .. tostring(propName))
		return
	end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return end
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if not propDef then return end

	if typeDef.directAccess then
		if propDef.nonNegative then
			value = _clampNonNegativeSeq(value)
		end
		if propDef.attribute then
			local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
			item:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
		else
			pcall(function() item[propName] = value end)
		end
		_bumpPoolGen(item)
		return
	end

	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return end

	local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)

	if propDef.type == "enum" then
		if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, value.Name)
		else
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, tostring(value))
		end
	else
		-- nonNegative: clamp NumberSequence Value AND Envelope so Value + rand[-E,+E] >= 0.
		if propDef.nonNegative and typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
			local kps = value.Keypoints
			local needsClamp = false
			for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
				if kp.Value < 0 or kp.Envelope > kp.Value then needsClamp = true; break end
			end
			if needsClamp then
				local clamped = {}
				for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
					local v = math.max(0, kp.Value)
					local e = math.max(0, math.min(kp.Envelope, v))
					table.insert(clamped, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, v, e))
				end
				value = NumberSequence.new(clamped)
			end
		end
		config:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
	end
	_bumpPoolGen(item)
end

-- Read every property into a flat table (generic GetData).
function TypeRegistry.readAll(item): {[string]: any}?
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end

	local data = {}
	for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)
		local raw = config:GetAttribute(attrName)
		if raw == nil then
			data[propName] = propDef.default
		elseif propDef.type == "enum" and type(raw) == "string" then
			data[propName] = Enum[propDef.enumType][raw]
		else
			data[propName] = promoteScalar(propDef, raw)
		end
	end
	return data
end

-- Stamp every default property; called by Transform.
function TypeRegistry.writeDefaults(config, typeDef)
	for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
		local value = propDef.default
		if propDef.type == "enum" then
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, value.Name)
		else
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
		end
	end
end

-- New Configuration with defaults stamped; parented to item.
function TypeRegistry.createConfig(item, typeDef)
	local config = Instance.new("Configuration")
	config.Name = TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME
	TypeRegistry.writeDefaults(config, typeDef)
	config.Parent = item
	return config
end

function TypeRegistry.isGraph(propDef): boolean
	return propDef.type == "NumberSequence" or propDef.type == "ColorSequence"
end

function TypeRegistry.isNonNegative(propDef): boolean
	return propDef.nonNegative == true
end

function TypeRegistry.getPropDef(typeName, propName)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	return typeDef.properties[propName]
end

-- Type-aware default lookup; required because pairs() over Types isn't order-stable.
function TypeRegistry.getDefault(typeName, propName)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if not propDef then return nil end
	return propDef.default
end

-- True when `desc` sits under a RenderTemplate between itself and `root` (exclusive).
-- Lifecycle.haltEmission skips such natives: they are template state, not live emission.
function TypeRegistry.isInsideRenderTemplate(desc, root)
	local node = desc.Parent
	while node and node ~= root do
		if node.Name == "RenderTemplate" then return true end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return false
end

return TypeRegistry

--[[
	TypeData  -  property descriptors for 3D / workspace types (Part / Beam / PointLight /
	Attachment / Model / Trail). Screen types live in TypeDataScreen.luau (500-line split).

	Property entry: { type, default, attrName?, enumType?, nonNegative?, attribute? }
	  attrName    config attribute name override (avoids collision with native props)
	  enumType    Roblox Enum category name (required for type="enum")
	  nonNegative NumberSequence keypoints clamped to >= 0 on write
	  attribute   directAccess only  -  store as instance attribute, not property
]]

local TypeData = {}

TypeData.PartProperties = {
	-- Graph properties (NumberSequence)
	Brightness    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },
	Color         = { type = "ColorSequence", default = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)) },
	SizeX         = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },
	SizeY         = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },
	SizeZ         = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },
	Transparency  = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	Speed         = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	-- Per-axis position offset graphs over normalized life (studs, spawn-local frame).
	-- Trajectory shape, distinct from emit-time PosX/Y/Z NumberRange spreads below.
	-- Composed ADDITIVELY with Speed × Direction via per-frame delta accumulation.
	PosOffsetX    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	PosOffsetY    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	PosOffsetZ    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	-- Perlin wander: amplitude envelope (studs) + noise frequency (Turbulence.luau).
	Turbulence          = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	TurbulenceFrequency = { type = "number", default = 1 },
	RotSpeedX     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	RotSpeedY     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	RotSpeedZ     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	-- Timescale graph: scales per-frame elapsed-time advancement. Default constant 1
	-- means real-time playback. <1 slows, 0 freezes, >1 speeds up, NEGATIVE rewinds (v2).
	-- Sampled at REAL normalized time `(now - StartTime) / LifeTime` so the graph
	-- progresses monotonically through its keypoints regardless of which direction
	-- the particle's effective time is moving. Initial `_effectiveElapsed` depends on
	-- the graph's value at i=0: ts(0) >= 0 → particle starts at 0 and plays forward;
	-- ts(0) < 0 → particle starts at LifeTime (end-state visual) and rewinds to 0.
	-- This is what makes a STATIC `Timescale = -1` produce end-to-start playback.
	-- Runtime: `dt *= ts(real_i)`, `_effectiveElapsed += dt` clamped to [0, LifeTime].
	-- Death rule: ONLY after the graph has finished playing (real_i >= 1) does a
	-- boundary cross (effective hit 0 or LifeTime) trigger death. During graph
	-- playback the particle bounces freely between bounds  -  users can author graphs
	-- that overshoot either bound without prematurely killing the particle. Sticky-
	-- zero post-graph (last-keypoint ts == 0 + effective stuck mid-life) is
	-- documented user error: no real-time cap, particle leaks the slot.
	Timescale     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },

	-- Non-graph properties
	Lifetime          = { type = "NumberRange",  default = NumberRange.new(1) },
	Rate              = { type = "number",       default = 10 },
	Drag              = { type = "number",       default = 0 },
	Acceleration      = { type = "Vector3",      default = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) },
	SpreadAngle       = { type = "Vector2",      default = Vector2.new(0, 0) },
	RotX              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	RotY              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	RotZ              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	PosX              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	PosY              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	PosZ              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	PosMode           = { type = "string",       default = "Local" },
	RotMode           = { type = "string",       default = "OverLife" },
	RotOrder          = { type = "string",       default = "Global" },
	TotalKeyFrames    = { type = "number",       default = 100 },
	PartLife          = { type = "number",       default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	ShapePartial      = { type = "number",       default = 0 },
	VelocityVectored  = { type = "boolean",      default = false },
	DirMode           = { type = "string",       default = "RigidLocal" },
	-- Frame for PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graphs. Mirrors DirMode's role for
	-- Speed but applied to displacement-through-life instead of velocity.
	-- Global = world axes; Local = particle's spawn frame (post-RotXYZ);
	-- RigidLocal = emitter's frame at spawn (pre-RotXYZ).
	DisplacementMode  = { type = "string",       default = "Global" },
	InvertMotion      = { type = "boolean",      default = false },
	Enabled           = { type = "boolean",      default = false },

	-- Target acceleration. AccelerationTowardsInstance gates the AccelStrength + AccelTarget pair.
	-- AccelStrength is a scalar magnitude over normalized particle lifetime; negative repels.
	-- AccelTarget is the picked instance (stored as ObjectValue child, not attribute -- see Transform).
	AccelerationTowardsInstance = { type = "boolean",        default = false },
	AccelStrength               = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },

	-- Axis links: per-axis "LinkedTo" attribute names the primary axis whose graph + seed (or
	-- per-emit sampled range value) the follower axis should adopt. Stored as full property
	-- keys (e.g. SizeYLinkedTo = "SizeX"). Registered here so QOL snapshot/Migrate see them.
	-- Default "" means unlinked; GetData sanitizes empty/invalid values to nil. Clipboard
	-- companion-copy (auto-include LinkedTo when its primary axis is copied) is a separate
	-- piece of work  -  registration alone does not make per-prop clipboard preserve them.
	SizeXLinkedTo        = { type = "string", default = "" },
	SizeYLinkedTo        = { type = "string", default = "" },
	SizeZLinkedTo        = { type = "string", default = "" },
	RotSpeedXLinkedTo    = { type = "string", default = "" },
	RotSpeedYLinkedTo    = { type = "string", default = "" },
	RotSpeedZLinkedTo    = { type = "string", default = "" },
	PosOffsetXLinkedTo   = { type = "string", default = "" },
	PosOffsetYLinkedTo   = { type = "string", default = "" },
	PosOffsetZLinkedTo   = { type = "string", default = "" },
	RotXLinkedTo         = { type = "string", default = "" },
	RotYLinkedTo         = { type = "string", default = "" },
	RotZLinkedTo         = { type = "string", default = "" },
	PosXLinkedTo         = { type = "string", default = "" },
	PosYLinkedTo         = { type = "string", default = "" },
	PosZLinkedTo         = { type = "string", default = "" },
	-- EvenDistribution: per-axis toggle. When true + EmitIndex/EmitCount in emitCtx,
	-- the axis samples a deterministic spread across [Min, Max] instead of random.
	-- EnableEmit batches use the natural EmitCount; rate-mode emits use a per-property
	-- rolling cycle (PositionEvenCycle / RotationEvenCycle) per Lifecycle.luau loopBody.
	-- Linked followers inherit the primary's spread scalar via AxisLinks.sampleRangeAxes.
	RotXEven             = { type = "boolean", default = false },
	RotYEven             = { type = "boolean", default = false },
	RotZEven             = { type = "boolean", default = false },
	PosXEven             = { type = "boolean", default = false },
	PosYEven             = { type = "boolean", default = false },

	of TypeData.luau (TypeDataRocks pattern).
	Graph keys carry the prefix Drive so generic code (the Timescale override, the Resize tool's
	scaleGraphs, the item's own loop Rate) never takes one for the item's own property.

local Container = {}

-- Stored as the panel's Mode dropdown shows them; Container/Clock compares these strings.

Container.APPLY_KINDS = { "Emitter", "Mesh", "Beam", "Trail", "Reactor" }
-- Panel row -> the Drive keys it stands for. A row's asterisk sets the config attribute

	DriveTimescale = "multiply",
	DriveBrightness = "multiply",
	DriveSpreadX = "add",

--[[
	TypeDataDistortion  -  Distortion type definition (screen-space glass
	distortion canvas; runtime in Modules/Part/Distortion/). Merged into
	TypeData.Types at the bottom of TypeData.luau (TypeDataLightning pattern).

	A Distortion item is a transformed BasePart discriminated by the
	IsDistortion attribute. Every active effect sums its height field into ONE
	shared camera-locked glass plane (Distortion/Canvas.luau)  -  overlapping
	glass planes cull each other, so per-effect planes cannot exist.
]]

local Distortion = {}

Distortion.DistortionProperties = {
	-- Field selection + shape. All screen-space quantities live in plane UV
	-- units (the canvas is 8x5 plane-studs); they are world-scale-invariant.
	FieldKind    = { type = "string", default = "Ripple" },
	-- Vertex displacement envelope over life (slope-normalized at write time
	-- so perceived strength is FOV- and wavelength-invariant).
	Amplitude    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0.5), nonNegative = true },
	Wavelength   = { type = "number", default = 1.5, nonNegative = true },
	-- SIGNED: negative = inward ripple / reversed wave / reversed scroll.
	Speed        = { type = "number", default = 3 },
	-- Degrees; Wave travel + Noise scroll direction.
	Direction    = { type = "number", default = 0 },
	NoiseScale   = { type = "number", default = 2, nonNegative = true },
	-- Bulge/Pinch dome radius (UV studs).
	LensRadius   = { type = "number", default = 1.5, nonNegative = true },

	-- Epicenter: WorldPoint = the item's live position (or moving nested clone,
	-- or Events AtPosition override) projected to the screen each frame;
	-- ScreenCenter = fixed center.
	EpicenterMode = { type = "string", default = "WorldPoint" },
	-- Camera-to-epicenter linear attenuation in world studs; 0 = global
	-- (ShakeFalloff semantics).
	Falloff      = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },

	-- Plane glass Transparency over life: 1 = invisible, ~0.5-0.75 = peak
	-- refraction, below ~0.5 = dark semi-mirror, above 1 = overdrive request
	-- (engine-quirk zone, effective ~4-10). MIN-composed across active effects
	-- (strongest glass wins). Default fades out so the plane never pops.
	Transparency = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0.3, 1), nonNegative = true },
	-- Software gain on this item's height contribution (always safe).
	Strength     = { type = "number", default = 1, nonNegative = true },
	-- Transparency>1 overdrive request (effective 4..10; 0 = off). Plane-global,
	-- composed by MAX across active effects; vetoed unless EVERY active effect
	-- opted in via AllowOverdrive (conservative wins).
	Amplify        = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	AllowOverdrive = { type = "boolean", default = false },
	-- Mesh grid width (verts across; height keeps the 24:14 aspect). The plane
	-- is shared: the HIGHEST active request wins, and it never downgrades until
	-- teardown. Cost scales quadratically  -  OptCalc reflects it.
	Resolution     = { type = "number", default = 24, nonNegative = true },

	-- Standard timing family. Timescale supports signed reverse (negative
	-- segments run the field animation backward).
	Timescale      = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },
	Lifetime       = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(0.5) },
	Rate           = { type = "number", default = 10 },
	Enabled        = { type = "boolean", default = false },
	TotalKeyFrames = { type = "number", default = 100 },
}

Distortion.Types = {
	Distortion = {
		-- IsDistortion stamped by Actions.TransformSelectionAsDistortion BEFORE
		-- Transform; config-child requirement keeps this disjoint from Part's
		-- classCheck under getTypeFor's unordered iteration.
		classCheck = function(item)
			return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") == true
				and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") ~= nil
		end,
		pDataType = "Distortion",
		uiSection = "Distortions",
		properties = Distortion.DistortionProperties,

		-- Screen-space props (Amplitude/Wavelength/LensRadius) are world-scale-
		-- invariant; only the world-distance Falloff scales.
		resize = {
			scaleNumbers = { "Falloff" },
		},
		retime = {
			multiplyNumbers = { "Rate", "Speed" },
			divideRanges = { "Lifetime" },
		},
		clipboard = {
			{name = "Emission", props = {"Rate", "Lifetime", "Timescale", "EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
			{name = "Field", props = {"FieldKind", "Amplitude", "Wavelength", "Speed", "Direction", "NoiseScale", "LensRadius"}},
			{name = "Screen", props = {"EpicenterMode", "Falloff", "Strength", "Transparency", "Amplify", "AllowOverdrive", "Resolution"}},
			{name = "Advanced", props = {"TotalKeyFrames"}},
			{name = "Events", props = {"OnEmit", "OnDeath", "OnDestruction"}},
		},
	},
}

return Distortion

--[[
	TypeDataForce  -  Force type definition: a transformed Part or Attachment that draws nothing
	and pushes Reactor pieces while it lives (runtime in Modules/Part/Force/). Merged into
	TypeData.Types at the bottom of TypeData.luau (TypeDataCameraShake pattern).

	An Impulse lasts as long as its front needs to cross the shape (Travel Time, or one instant
	at 0); Lifetime is the length of a Continuous force, and of an Impulse that travels (one
	with a Link or any Motion).

	Spawn, Motion and Link are a mesh's: the same properties under the same names, placed and
	moved by the mesh's own code (Modules/Part/Force/Path). Link is item-level, as on a mesh.
]]

local Force = {}

-- Stored as the panel's dropdowns show them; Force/Fields and Force/init compare these strings.
Force.SHAPES = { "Sphere", "Cone", "Linear", "Vortex" }
Force.KINDS = { "Impulse", "Continuous" }

-- The Spawn and Motion properties a Force shares with a mesh. TypeData.luau copies each
-- definition from PartProperties at the merge, so there is one definition of each.
Force.FROM_PART = {
	"PosMode", "PosX", "PosY", "PosZ", "PosXEven", "PosYEven", "PosZEven", "PositionEvenCycle",
	"RotOrder", "RotX", "RotY", "RotZ", "RotXEven", "RotYEven", "RotZEven", "RotationEvenCycle",
	"PosXLinkedTo", "PosYLinkedTo", "PosZLinkedTo", "RotXLinkedTo", "RotYLinkedTo", "RotZLinkedTo",
	"SpreadAngle", "DirMode", "VelocityVectored", "Speed", "Acceleration", "Drag", "InvertMotion",
	"DisplacementMode", "PosOffsetX", "PosOffsetY", "PosOffsetZ", "TurbulenceFrequency",
	"PosOffsetXLinkedTo", "PosOffsetYLinkedTo", "PosOffsetZLinkedTo",
	"RotMode", "RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ",
	"RotSpeedXLinkedTo", "RotSpeedYLinkedTo", "RotSpeedZLinkedTo",
	"AccelerationTowardsInstance", "AccelStrength",
}

Force.ForceProperties = {
	Shape = { type = "string", default = "Sphere" },
	-- Impulse: one kick as the front passes. Continuous: a flow that carries pieces while it lasts.
	ActsAs = { type = "string", default = "Impulse" },
	-- Over the force's life. Impulse: how far, in studs, a piece at the origin is thrown
	-- (Force/Fields.throwSpeed). Continuous: the speed, in studs per second, pieces are carried
	-- at (Reactor/Driven). Negative pulls.
	Strength = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(12) },
	-- How much of the Strength is lost by the edge of the shape, 0 to 1: 1 fades to nothing
	-- there, 0 pushes as hard at the edge as at the origin. The runtime keeps it in that range.
	Falloff = { type = "number", default = 1, nonNegative = true },

	-- Reach in studs: a Sphere's or Cone's radius, a Linear's length, a Vortex's radius.
	Range = { type = "number", default = 30, nonNegative = true },
	-- Nothing closer than this is pushed.
	Inner = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- Linear: the box's cross-section. Vortex: Height is its length along the axis.
	Width = { type = "number", default = 20, nonNegative = true },
	Height = { type = "number", default = 20, nonNegative = true },
	-- Cone: the full opening angle in degrees.
	Angle = { type = "number", default = 60, nonNegative = true },
	-- The face of the item the shape points along.
	EmissionDirection = { type = "enum", enumType = "NormalId", default = Enum.NormalId.Front },
	-- Motion's Direction: the face of the item the Force travels along. A mesh keeps this in
	-- EmissionDirection, which a Force already uses for its shape.
	MoveDirection = { type = "enum", enumType = "NormalId", default = Enum.NormalId.Front },
	-- Motion's Turbulence: wander of the Force's own path, in studs over its life. A mesh keeps
	-- this in Turbulence, which a Force already uses for gusts.
	MotionTurbulence = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },

	-- Seconds the push takes to travel from the origin to the edge of the shape, so far pieces
	-- react after near ones; 0 reaches everything at once.
	TravelTime = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- Impulse: an upward share added to the kick. Vortex: the share along its axis. A Continuous
	-- Sphere, Cone or Linear goes where its shape points and ignores it.
	Lift = { type = "number", default = 0.7 },
	-- Vortex: the shares of Strength around the axis and toward it.
	Spin = { type = "number", default = 1 },
	Pull = { type = "number", default = 0.5 },

	-- Random spread of the strength each piece feels, 0 to 1.
	Variation = { type = "number", default = 0.2, nonNegative = true },
	-- Continuous: gusts, as a share of Strength each piece's speed swings by over time.
	Turbulence = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- 0: every piece is thrown alike. 1: a piece twice the reference size is thrown half as far.
	-- A small piece is never thrown farther than Strength.
	SizeResponse = { type = "number", default = 0.5, nonNegative = true },
	-- Reactors with this Group react; empty reaches every Reactor.
	Group = { type = "string", default = "" },

	Lifetime = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(1), nonNegative = true },
	-- A graph over the Lifetime, read in real time as a mesh's Timescale is. It runs the Force's
	-- own clock (front, strength, path) and the Reactors whose pieces the Force moves: 0.25 is
	-- quarter speed, 0 holds the debris in the air. A Force with one lasts its Lifetime. When
	-- the Lifetime is over time runs normally again, so a graph that eases out ends at 1.
	-- Nothing rewinds: a value below 0 is 0. Flat at 1, the default, is no Timescale at all.
	Timescale = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },
	Rate = { type = "number", default = 2 },
	Enabled = { type = "boolean", default = false },
}

--[[
	TypeDataReactor  -  Reactor type definition: a transformed Model or Part whose parts are
	pieces that Forces push (runtime in Modules/Part/Reactor/). Merged into TypeData.Types at
	the bottom of TypeData.luau (TypeDataCameraShake pattern).
	A Reactor has no RenderTemplate and emits nothing: its parts stay as they were built, and a
	play moves unsaved stand-ins of them.
]]

local Reactor = {}

-- Stored as the panel's dropdowns show them; Reactor/Play and Reactor/Pieces compare these strings.
Reactor.AFTER = { "Stay", "Fade", "Return" }
Reactor.BREAK = { "None", "Blocks", "Shards" }
Reactor.SHARD_PATTERNS = { "Even", "Around hit" }
Reactor.SCATTER_TURN = { "Upright", "Any way" }
Reactor.SCATTER_SHAPES = { "Box", "Circle", "Region shape" }

Reactor.ReactorProperties = {
	-- The throw, in studs, a piece shrugs off: a Force that would move it no farther leaves it standing.
	Hold = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- How much Hold differs from piece to piece, 0 to 1: at 0.3 a piece holds 0.7 to 1.3 of it,
	-- so a wall gives way unevenly.
	HoldSpread = { type = "number", default = 0.3, nonNegative = true },
	-- None: every part moves whole. Blocks: a plain block-shaped Part is cut into blocks about
	-- Piece Size across (Reactor/Dice), each a piece of its own; any other part still moves whole.
	-- Shards: every part that draws its own shape (a Part, a wedge, a mesh, a union) is cut by
	-- the engine into about Pieces real fragments (Reactor/Shards); a Part carrying a mesh and a
	-- truss still move whole.
	Break = { type = "string", default = "None" },
	PieceSize = { type = "number", default = 2, nonNegative = true },
	-- Shards a part breaks into, each part on its own; at most Reactor/Sites.MAX, and fewer
	-- for a very small part.
	Pieces = { type = "number", default = 50, nonNegative = true },
	-- Even: shards of about one size, cut ahead so the first Force is answered at once.
	-- Around hit: small where the first Force is and large away from it; the cut can only be
	-- made when that Force arrives, so the Reactor answers it a few frames late.
	ShardPattern = { type = "string", default = "Even" },
	-- A piece left standing with nothing under or beside it that still reaches the ground is let
	-- go and falls (Reactor/Support). One that floats from the start is never made to fall.
	Collapse = { type = "boolean", default = true },

	Group = { type = "string", default = "" },

	TumbleSpeed = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(90, 360) },
	-- Seconds a piece may stay in the air. Its path looks for ground that long, so a piece

	AfterDelay = { type = "number", default = 2, nonNegative = true },
	-- Seconds the Fade or the Return takes.
	AfterTime = { type = "number", default = 1.5, nonNegative = true },

	ScatterCount = { type = "number", default = 40, nonNegative = true },
	-- The clear ground between two placed pieces, in studs; 0 lets them touch.

	ScatterSeed = { type = "number", default = 1 },

	ScatterShape = { type = "string", default = "Box" },
	ScatterHollow = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },

		classCheck = function(item)

--[[
	Update Mixin  -  per-frame update for Part / Beam (Attachment lives in UpdateAttachment.luau).
	Returns true when Lifetime expires (swap-and-pop or animate-loop reset).
	Hot-path zero-allocation contract: no CFrame/Vector3/table creation in step loops.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local UpdateCommon = require(script.Parent.UpdateCommon)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local ContainerColors = require(script.Parent.Container.Colors)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local _posOffsetFrameDelta = UpdateCommon._posOffsetFrameDelta
local _composeLocalDelta = UpdateCommon._composeLocalDelta

-- World position for target-accel; nil for destroyed / no-Position types.
-- Bone before BasePart (Bone IS-A BasePart but .Position is bind pose, not live).
local function getTargetPosition(target)
	if not target or not target.Parent then return nil end
	if target:IsA("Bone") then return target.TransformedWorldCFrame.Position end
	if target:IsA("BasePart") then return target.Position end
	if target:IsA("Attachment") then return target.WorldPosition end
	if target:IsA("Camera") then return target.CFrame.Position end
	if target:IsA("Model") then local ok, cf = pcall(target.GetPivot, target); if ok and cf then return cf.Position end end
	return nil
end

-- A Container's hold on this particle's look (its carried record, pData._drive): the
-- record's brightness multiplies, its colour acts by the Container's Color Mode.
local function drivenLook(pData, color, brightness)
	local drive = pData._drive
	if not drive then
		return color, brightness
	end
	if drive.look then
		color = ContainerColors.driven(pData, color, drive)
	end
	return color, brightness * drive.brightness
end

return function(Particle)

-- Part update: position (4 branches), rotation, size, color/transparency, flipbook.
-- Branches: Inverted reads precomputed CFrames; VelocityVectored needs full per-step iteration;
-- fast paths skip ahead with no accel/drag.
function Particle:UpdatePart(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: ts sampled at real_i (not effective i) so it progresses
	-- monotonically through keypoints regardless of effective-time direction. ts(0)<0 →
	-- particle starts at end of life and rewinds; ts(0)>=0 → starts forward.
	-- SetTimescale override (Lifecycle.luau) wins over the graph for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	-- Carried by a Container: its Timescale graph runs this particle's time too.
	local drive = pData._drive
	if drive then ts = ts * drive.timescale end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	-- Particle dies when effective sits at a boundary AND the graph has finished playing.
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	-- OnHit Collision=Stop (or auto-settle freeze): skip motion/step work, age normally.
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end

	-- Nested-Model scale: fold the parent Model's current scale into nested-particle motion.
	-- motionFactor scales the spatial delta (Speed/Accel/PosOffset) when ScaleMotion; rotFactor
	-- scales RotSpeed (via rotDamp) when ScaleRotation; sizeFactor scales Size. 1 when not nested.
	local sizeFactor, motionFactor, rotFactor = 1, 1, 1
	if pData.ParentScale then
		sizeFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod)
		motionFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "motion")
		rotFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "rotation")
	end
	-- A Container's Scale graph sizes the mesh; its motion is its own.
	if drive then sizeFactor = sizeFactor * drive.scale end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local perStepDT = pData.AccumulatedDT / stepsToProcess
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0

		-- Collision spin (deg/sec) into _spinAccum (degrees); composes with both rotation modes.
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1

		-- POSITION: Inverted
		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			local parentCF_now = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration then
			-- parentCF_now / dirInfo hoisted outside the loop; final CFrame written once at batch end.
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
			local localCF = pData.LocalCF
			local accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ = pData.AccRotX, pData.AccRotY, pData.AccRotZ
			local baseDir = pData.BaseDirection
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			local targetVel = pData.TargetVel
			-- Seed simPos from live VisualPart.Position (overlays moved CFrame since CurrentPosition write).
			local simPos = pData.VisualPart.Position
			local rotMode = pData.RotMode
			local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"
			local lastWorldCF, lastLocalWorldCF
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (baseDir * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = baseDir * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- Target accel: Euler integration; reads simPos for mid-substep tracking.
				if pData.HasTargetAccel then
					local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
					if tPos then
						local toTarget = tPos - simPos
						local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
						if dist > 1e-4 then
							local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
							if mag and mag ~= 0 then
								targetVel = targetVel + toTarget * (mag * perStepDT / dist)
								displacement = displacement + targetVel * perStepDT
							end
						end
					end
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. Telescoping sums integrate to the absolute-offset
				-- change. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the velocity; a Local-mode offset is
				-- already link-local and added as-is (else a spinning Weld precesses it).
				local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si, useVOS)
				local parentLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, displacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
				localCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * localCF

				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotationCFrame
				local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
				local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
				local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
				if rotMode == "Speed" then
					accRotX = accRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					accRotY = accRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					accRotZ = accRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, accRotX + sx, accRotY + sy, accRotZ + sz)
				else
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX + sx, rotSpeedY + sy, rotSpeedZ + sz)
				end

				lastWorldCF = (parentCF_now * localCF) * rotationCFrame
				lastLocalWorldCF = localCF * rotationCFrame
				simPos = lastWorldCF.Position

				local rotatedCF = lastWorldCF * pData.SpreadRotation
				baseDir = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			end
			pData.LocalCF = localCF
			pData.AccRotX, pData.AccRotY, pData.AccRotZ = accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ
			pData.BaseDirection = baseDir
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.TargetVel = targetVel
			pData.CurrentPosition = simPos
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			if lastWorldCF then
				pData.VisualPart.CFrame = lastWorldCF
				pData._localWorldCF = lastLocalWorldCF
			end

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp

			-- Target accel: frame-granularity (mid-frame si).
			if pData.HasTargetAccel then
				local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
				if tPos then
					local toTarget = tPos - pData.VisualPart.Position
					local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
					if dist > 1e-4 then
						local frameDT2 = perStepDT * (targetStep - prevStep)
						local midSI = ((prevStep + 1 + targetStep) * 0.5) / pData.TotalKeyFrames
						local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(midSI, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
						if mag and mag ~= 0 then
							pData.TargetVel = pData.TargetVel + toTarget * (mag * frameDT2 / dist)
							totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + pData.TargetVel * frameDT2
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life position graphs. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the
			-- world velocity; a Local-mode offset is already link-local and added as-is so a
			-- spinning Weld lets the radius shrink instead of precessing the offset.
			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames, useVOS)
			local parentLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, totalDisplacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = (parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST
		else
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			-- Drag-free closed form: speed integral + (accelVel*Δt + 0.5*accel*Δt²).
			if not hasDrag then
				local invTKF = 1 / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local prevT = prevStep * invTKF
				local targetT = targetStep * invTKF
				local override = pData._speedOverride
				if override then
					totalScalarDisp = override * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				elseif pData._staticSpeed then
					-- Constant Speed integrates to value × duration.
					totalScalarDisp = pData._staticSpeed * speedMult * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				else
					totalScalarDisp = pData.LifeTime * speedMult * (GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(targetT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) - GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(prevT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed))
				end
				if hasAccel then
					local deltaSec = (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, deltaSec)
					totalAccelDisp = accelVel * deltaSec + effA * (deltaSec * deltaSec * 0.5)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * deltaSec
				end
			else
				-- Drag fallback: per-step loop.
				for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
					local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
					local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
					local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
					speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)
					totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
					if hasAccel then
						local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
						accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
						totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
					end
				end
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp

			-- Target accel: frame-granularity sample.
			if pData.HasTargetAccel then
				local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
				if tPos then
					local toTarget = tPos - pData.VisualPart.Position
					local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
					if dist > 1e-4 then
						local frameDT = perStepDT * (targetStep - prevStep)
						local midSI = ((prevStep + 1 + targetStep) * 0.5) / pData.TotalKeyFrames
						local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(midSI, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
						if mag and mag ~= 0 then
							pData.TargetVel = pData.TargetVel + toTarget * (mag * frameDT / dist)
							totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + pData.TargetVel * frameDT
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- PosOffset over-life graphs. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the velocity; a Local-mode
			-- offset is link-local and added as-is (no precession on a spinning Weld).
			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames, useVOS)
			local parentLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, totalDisplacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF

			local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
			local rotX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumX or 0)
			local rotY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumY or 0)
			local rotZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumZ or 0)
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", rotX, rotY, rotZ)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = (parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		end

		-- SIZE  -  gated by pData.SkipSize (set via payload.SetSkipSize).
		local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		if not pData.SkipSize then
			local sizex = pData._staticSizeX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SizeX, pData.Seeds.SizeX)
			local sizey = pData._staticSizeY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SizeY, pData.Seeds.SizeY)
			local sizez = pData._staticSizeZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SizeZ, pData.Seeds.SizeZ)

			-- Nested-Model scale on Size (always-on; independent of ScaleMotion). sizeFactor
			-- hoisted once at function top via Constants.getParentScaleFactor.
			if sizeFactor ~= 1 then
				sizex = sizex * sizeFactor
				sizey = sizey * sizeFactor
				sizez = sizez * sizeFactor
			end

			if pData.SpecialMesh then
				pData.SpecialMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(sizex, sizey, sizez)
			else
				pData.VisualPart.Size = Vector3.new(sizex, sizey, sizez)
			end
		end

		-- VISUAL
		local transparency = pData._staticTransparency or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Transparency, pData.Seeds.Transparency)

		if pData.SurfaceAppearance then
			-- Color graph tints SA.Color raw; Brightness graph drives SA.EmissiveTint only.
			-- EmissiveTint write pcall-guarded for older Studio builds without the property.
			local brightness = pData._staticBrightness or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)
			local color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Color)
			color, brightness = drivenLook(pData, color, brightness)
			if not pData.SkipTransparency then pData.VisualPart.Transparency = transparency end
			if not pData.SkipColor then
				pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255, color.G * 255, color.B * 255)
				pData.SurfaceAppearance.Color = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255, color.G * 255, color.B * 255)
				pcall(function() pData.SurfaceAppearance.EmissiveTint = Color3.new(color.R * brightness, color.G * brightness, color.B * brightness) end)
			end
		elseif pData.HasDecal and not pData.DecalLayersMode then
			local brightness = pData._staticBrightness or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)
			local color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Color)
			color, brightness = drivenLook(pData, color, brightness)
			if not pData.SkipTransparency then pData.Decal.Transparency = transparency end
			if not pData.SkipColor then pData.Decal.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255 * brightness, color.G * 255 * brightness, color.B * 255 * brightness) end
		else
			-- Mesh: Brightness scales the mesh colour in decal-layers mode; legacy plain meshes ignore it.
			local color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Color)
			local brightness = 1
			if pData.DecalLayersMode then
				brightness = pData._staticBrightness or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)
			end
			color, brightness = drivenLook(pData, color, brightness)
			if not pData.SkipTransparency then pData.VisualPart.Transparency = transparency end
			if not pData.SkipColor then pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255 * brightness, color.G * 255 * brightness, color.B * 255 * brightness) end
			if pData.Layers then DecalLayersMod.write(pData, steppedI) end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	UpdateAttachment Mixin  -  per-frame update for Attachment particles, split from Update.luau
	for the 500-line cap. Composes in the visual parent's space (LinkCF.attachmentParentFrame).
	Hot-path zero-allocation contract: no CFrame/Vector3/table creation in step loops.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local UpdateCommon = require(script.Parent.UpdateCommon)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local _posOffsetFrameDelta = UpdateCommon._posOffsetFrameDelta
local _composeLocalDelta = UpdateCommon._composeLocalDelta

return function(Particle)

-- Attachment update: parent-local motion. No Size graph (Attachments drive child instances).
function Particle:UpdateAttachment(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end

	-- Nested-Model scale (see UpdatePart): motionFactor scales the spatial delta, rotFactor
	-- scales RotSpeed via rotDamp, sizeFactor scales Size. 1 when not nested.
	local sizeFactor, motionFactor, rotFactor = 1, 1, 1
	if pData.ParentScale then
		sizeFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod)
		motionFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "motion")
		rotFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "rotation")
	end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)
	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local perStepDT = pData.AccumulatedDT / stepsToProcess
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1

		-- actualParent-local link CFrame; identity when no link.
		local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.attachmentParentFrame(pData)

		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
			pData.LocalCF = localCF
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (pData.BaseDirection * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = pData.BaseDirection * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the world velocity into
				-- link-local; a Local-mode offset is already link-local and added as-is.
				local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si, useVOS)
				local stepDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, displacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
				pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(stepDelta) * pData.LocalCF

				-- Rotation
				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotationCFrame
				if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
					pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)
				else
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX + sx, rotSpeedY + sy, rotSpeedZ + sz)
				end

				pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
				pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame

				local rotatedCF = pData.VisualPart.CFrame * pData.SpreadRotation
				local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
				pData.BaseDirection = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames, useVOS)
			local stepDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, totalDisplacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(stepDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST
		else
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			-- Drag-free closed form: speed integral + (accelVel*Δt + 0.5*accel*Δt²).
			if not hasDrag then
				local invTKF = 1 / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local prevT = prevStep * invTKF
				local targetT = targetStep * invTKF
				local override = pData._speedOverride
				if override then
					totalScalarDisp = override * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				elseif pData._staticSpeed then
					-- Constant Speed integrates to value × duration.
					totalScalarDisp = pData._staticSpeed * speedMult * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				else
					totalScalarDisp = pData.LifeTime * speedMult * (GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(targetT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) - GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(prevT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed))
				end
				if hasAccel then
					local deltaSec = (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, deltaSec)
					totalAccelDisp = accelVel * deltaSec + effA * (deltaSec * deltaSec * 0.5)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * deltaSec
				end
			else
				for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
					local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
					local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
					local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
					speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)
					totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
					if hasAccel then
						local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
						accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
						totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
					end
				end
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames, useVOS)
			local stepDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, totalDisplacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(stepDelta) * pData.LocalCF

			local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
			local rotX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumX or 0)
			local rotY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumY or 0)
			local rotZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumZ or 0)
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", rotX, rotY, rotZ)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	UpdateBeam Mixin  -  per-frame update for Beam particles (no spatial motion).
	GraphBlender lerps between authored Transparency/Color states; pair-index cached for O(1) search.
	Animate-loop reset must clear _lastTransIdx/_lastColorIdx (init.luau handles this).
	TextureSpeed uses integral-based offset (engine's rate-accumulator is FPS-dependent).
	ParentScale multiplies Width/CurveSize/TextureLength/Segments by nested-Model scale factor.
	Carried by a Container (pData._drive, set by EmitBeam through Container/Lines.carry): the
	Container's Timescale runs this beam's clock, and Lines.driveBeam, LAST in the update, puts
	the rest of what it asks on top of what the beam's own graphs wrote this frame.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local ContainerLines = require(script.Parent.Container.Lines)
-- Transition eases read at fixed x; a shared empty seed keeps the hot loop allocation-free.
local EMPTY_SEED = {}
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame update for a Beam-typed particle (`pData`). Advances effective elapsed,
-- writes Width0/1, Color, Transparency from authored graphs + GraphBlender states.
-- Returns true when the particle has died.
function Particle:UpdateBeam(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local drive = pData._drive
	if drive then ts = ts * drive.timescale end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	-- Continuous-time, FPS-independent.
	local t = i

	local transStates = pData.TransStates
	local colorStates = pData.ColorStates

	-- Transparency blender
	if not pData.SkipTransparency then
		if transStates and #transStates >= 2 then
			local lastTrans = pData._lastTransIdx or 1
			-- Reverse-Timescale support: rescan from start when t dropped below cached pair's lower bound.
			if t < transStates[lastTrans].Time then lastTrans = 1 end
			local pairIdx = #transStates - 1
			for idx = lastTrans, #transStates - 1 do
				if t >= transStates[idx].Time and t <= transStates[idx + 1].Time then
					pairIdx = idx; break
				end
			end
			pData._lastTransIdx = pairIdx
			local lower = transStates[pairIdx]
			local upper = transStates[pairIdx + 1] or transStates[#transStates]
			local range = upper.Time - lower.Time
			local segmentAlpha = range > 0 and ((t - lower.Time) / range) or 0
			if upper.Transition then segmentAlpha = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(segmentAlpha, upper.Transition, EMPTY_SEED) end
			local mergedTimes = pData.TransMergedTimes[pairIdx]
			if mergedTimes then
				pData.VisualPart.Transparency = GraphMod.LerpGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
			else
				pData.VisualPart.Transparency = GraphMod.LerpGraph(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha)
			end
		elseif transStates and #transStates == 1 then
			pData.VisualPart.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph
		end
	end

	-- Color blender
	if not pData.SkipColor then
		if colorStates and #colorStates >= 2 then
			local lastColor = pData._lastColorIdx or 1
			if t < colorStates[lastColor].Time then lastColor = 1 end
			local pairIdx = #colorStates - 1
			for idx = lastColor, #colorStates - 1 do
				if t >= colorStates[idx].Time and t <= colorStates[idx + 1].Time then
					pairIdx = idx; break
				end
			end
			pData._lastColorIdx = pairIdx
			local lower = colorStates[pairIdx]
			local upper = colorStates[pairIdx + 1] or colorStates[#colorStates]
			local range = upper.Time - lower.Time
			local segmentAlpha = range > 0 and ((t - lower.Time) / range) or 0
			if upper.Transition then segmentAlpha = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(segmentAlpha, upper.Transition, EMPTY_SEED) end
			local mergedTimes = pData.ColorMergedTimes[pairIdx]
			if mergedTimes then
				pData.VisualPart.Color = GraphMod.LerpColorGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
			else
				pData.VisualPart.Color = GraphMod.LerpColorGraph(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha)
			end
		elseif colorStates and #colorStates == 1 then
			pData.VisualPart.Color = colorStates[1].Graph
		end
	end

	-- TextureSpeed: integral-based offset for FPS independence.
	local tsAnim = pData.AnimatedProps.TextureSpeed
	if tsAnim then
		local integral = GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(t, tsAnim.Sequence, tsAnim.Seed)
		pData.VisualPart:SetTextureOffset((-integral * pData.LifeTime) % 1)
	end

	-- Other animated beam properties (Width0, Width1, CurveSize, etc.)
	for name, animData in pairs(pData.AnimatedProps) do
		if name ~= "TextureSpeed" then
			local val = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, animData.Sequence, animData.Seed)
			if name == "Segments" then val = math.max(20, math.round(val)) end
			pData.VisualPart[name] = val
		end
	end

	-- Parent model scale (nested beams): the chain reads each owner's published _ownScale.
	if pData.ParentScale then
		local ps = pData.ParentScale
		local pFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(ps, currentTime, GraphMod)
		local vb = pData.VisualPart
		local ap = pData.AnimatedProps
		vb.Width0 = (ap.Width0 and vb.Width0 or pData._baseWidth0) * pFactor
		vb.Width1 = (ap.Width1 and vb.Width1 or pData._baseWidth1) * pFactor
		vb.CurveSize0 = (ap.CurveSize0 and vb.CurveSize0 or pData._baseCurveSize0) * pFactor
		vb.CurveSize1 = (ap.CurveSize1 and vb.CurveSize1 or pData._baseCurveSize1) * pFactor
		-- TextureLength multiplies (preserves tile count as beam scales) when Model's
		-- ScaleTextureLength attribute is true (default). False leaves authored value
		-- so tiles repeat more densely as beam grows.
		if ps.ScaleTextureLength ~= false then
			vb.TextureLength = (ap.TextureLength and vb.TextureLength or pData._baseTextureLength) * pFactor
		end
		vb.Segments = math.max(20, math.round((ap.Segments and vb.Segments or pData._baseSegments) * pFactor))
	end

	if drive then ContainerLines.driveBeam(pData) end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	UpdateCommon  -  per-frame displacement helpers shared by the Part and Attachment update mixins
	(Update.luau, UpdateAttachment.luau). UpdateModel keeps its own variant.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)

-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graph → per-frame delta added to displacement.
-- Difference-based: sample absolute offset at t_norm in the DisplacementMode
-- frame, subtract _prevWorldOff. LocalCF accumulator integrates correctly.
-- Three frames mirror DirMode (Speed direction):
--   Global     = world axes (no rotation applied)
--   Local      = SpawnRotation (post-RotXYZ particle frame; per-particle RotXYZ
--                rotates the path → fans / scatter / convergence patterns)
--   RigidLocal = SpawnEmitterRotation (emitter frame at spawn, pre-RotXYZ;
--                path follows emitter orientation but not particle tumble)
-- Returns (delta, isLinkLocal). isLinkLocal is true when the offset is already in
-- link-local space (Local mode under a useVOS link) and so must NOT be VOS'd again —
-- see _composeLocalDelta. Otherwise the delta is in world/emitter space like before.
local function _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, steppedI, useVOS)
	if not (pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs or pData.HasTurbulence) then return Vector3.zero, false end
	local delta = Vector3.zero
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData._staticPosOffsetX or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX)) or 0
		local oY = pData._staticPosOffsetY or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY)) or 0
		local oZ = pData._staticPosOffsetZ or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ)) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation,
			pData._displacementMirrorX, pData._displacementMirrorY, pData._displacementMirrorZ)
		delta = worldOff - pData._prevWorldOff
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
	end
	-- Turbulence keeps its own telescoping accumulator (_prevTurbOff): OnHit Bounce
	-- mirrors re-baseline only _prevWorldOff, and noise never mirrors.
	if pData.HasTurbulence then
		delta = delta + Turbulence.frameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	end
	-- Local mode's SpawnRotation is captured link-local under a link, so the delta is
	-- already link-local. Flag it so the apply site skips the second VOS that would
	-- precess it around a spinning Weld instead of letting the radius shrink.
	local isLinkLocal = useVOS and (pData.DisplacementMode or "Global") == "Local"
	return delta, isLinkLocal
end

-- Stack a frame's displacement into a link-local LocalCF accumulator. The world-built
-- velocity is VOS'd into link-local when welded; a link-local PosOffset is added as-is.
-- motionFactor scales the whole spatial delta (Speed + Accel + PosOffset) by the parent
-- Model's scale for nested particles (1 otherwise) — applied to the sum so it stays coherent.
local function _composeLocalDelta(parentCF, useVOS, velWorld, posDelta, posIsLinkLocal, motionFactor)
	if not useVOS then return (velWorld + posDelta) * motionFactor end
	local velLocal = parentCF:VectorToObjectSpace(velWorld)
	local posLocal = posIsLinkLocal and posDelta or parentCF:VectorToObjectSpace(posDelta)
	return (velLocal + posLocal) * motionFactor
end

local UpdateCommon = {}
UpdateCommon._posOffsetFrameDelta = _posOffsetFrameDelta
UpdateCommon._composeLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta

return UpdateCommon

--[[
	UpdateModel Mixin  -  per-frame update for Model particles.
	Same motion branches as UpdatePart; uses :PivotTo for position and :ScaleTo for size.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graph → per-frame delta added to displacement.
-- Routes through Constants.resolveDisplacement so DisplacementMode (Global / Local /
-- RigidLocal) + OnHit mirror axes apply uniformly with the Part / Attachment path
-- in Update.luau:_posOffsetFrameDelta.
local function _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	if not (pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs or pData.HasTurbulence) then return Vector3.zero end
	local delta = Vector3.zero
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData._staticPosOffsetX or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX)) or 0
		local oY = pData._staticPosOffsetY or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY)) or 0
		local oZ = pData._staticPosOffsetZ or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ)) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation,
			pData._displacementMirrorX, pData._displacementMirrorY, pData._displacementMirrorZ)
		delta = worldOff - pData._prevWorldOff
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
	end
	-- Turbulence keeps its own accumulator (_prevTurbOff); see Update.luau twin.
	if pData.HasTurbulence then
		delta = delta + Turbulence.frameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	end
	return delta
end

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame update for a Model-typed particle (`pData`). Advances effective elapsed,
-- writes the new pivot via :PivotTo, applies scale + flipbook. Returns true when the
-- particle has died (consumed by Engine.luau's swap-and-pop loop).
function Particle:UpdateModel(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
